newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines buys six Airbus A319. [CORRECTED 16:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines buys six Airbus A319. [CORRECTED 16:05 GMT]

text.p: Croatia's state-owned national flag carrier Croatia Airlines said on Monday it signed an agreement to buy six medium-range A319 aircraft from Airbus Industrie.
The agreement covers the purchase of six aircraft for delivery between year 1998 and 2000 and an option to buy another 10 aircraft by 2006, the company said in a statement"
Building of the first aircraft will begin immediately after the signing and will be delivered in January 1998.
Some 40 percent of the deal, estimated at $277 million, is to be offset by exports of Croatian goods, it said.
It is part of a larger purchase by Croatia Airlines to swap out its current nine-plane fleet and expand it by year 2006.

The agreement was signed in the presence of the Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa, visiting French minister Bernard Pons and French and German ambassadors to Zagreb, a government press officer said.
